name: Long wool scarf
description: A very long navy knitted scarf with two cream stripes and a fringe at each end. Worn loosely over the mouth and nose, it keeps out the cold, and there is enough of it left to wrap the head as well.
notes: Folded in four, 270 mm by 224 mm and 52 mm tall with its fringe: `cloth-navy` knit with rib lines, two `cloth-cream` stripes across the top fold. Slot `face`, as the cowl and bandanas over the face take. Wearing it as a headwrap is the draft `scarf_long_headwrap` on the same model. CHECK VOLUME (x2.5): the fold stack's box against the reference's packed bulk; loose wool. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Long wool scarf (head wrap)
description: A very long navy knitted scarf wrapped round the head as well as the face, warm enough for a hard frost.
notes: The same scarf as `scarf_long_loose`, worn wrapped over the head and mouth, so it rides on the `scarf_wool_long` model: off the body both look the same folded scarf. Slot `hood`, as headscarves take; it covers the face too, which one slot cannot express. Switching between the two ways of wearing it needs a wear-mode action in Deadvox, not authored here. CHECK VOLUME (x2.5) as for the loose scarf. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Prayer shawl
description: A large cream wool shawl banded in black near each end, with a woven silver neckband and knotted white fringes at its corners. It is worn over the shoulders and wraps the upper body.
notes: Folded square, 378 mm by 330 mm with its fringes and 36 mm tall: `cloth-cream` wool, three `cloth-black` bands near each end, a `cloth-shimmer` neckband along the back, two knotted `cloth-bright-white` fringes at the front corners, each a knot, a cord over the edge and six thin strands fanning out on the floor (the other two lie under the fold). Slot `cloak`, as wraps worn over everything take. CHECK VOLUME (x4.5): the box counts the fringes fanning out past the fold; folded wool. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Nylon throat guard
description: A padded black nylon collar with a rounded bib over the throat, closed at the back with a hook-and-loop tab. Made for hockey, it stops a skate blade or a slash across the neck.
notes: Standing on its edge, 134 mm across and 86 mm tall: a padded `nylon-black` band open at the back, the bib dropping 45 mm at the front, `cloth-charcoal` binding, `hook-loop-grey` tabs at the opening. Slot `neck`, as collars take; one slot means a necklace and a throat guard cannot be worn together (a separate `throat` slot would fix that, proposed in the report). The reference lists it as head cover with no encumbrance. CHECK VOLUME (x2.8): the open collar's box includes the neck hole. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.
